repos_data.description: The AI-native database built for LLM applications, providing incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text.

Project-aware collection management based on Qdrant, including a Rust MCP, daemon and CLI: hybrid semantic, pattern and full-text (FTS5) search into single or cross-concerns collection. Dedicated collections for knowledge library, LLM behavioral rules, and an LLM scratchpad
Qdrant - High-performance, massive-scale Vector Database and Vector Search Engine for the next generation of AI. Also available in the cloud https://cloud.qdrant.io/
Local RAG MCP server for Claude Code — hybrid search (semantic + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, 13 MCP tools, 20 format parsers. Zero external servers, zero API keys.
A lightning-fast search engine API bringing AI-powered hybrid search to your sites and applications.
One Postgres for your application data, full-text search, vector retrieval, and aggregations. Home of the pg_search extension.
💡 All-in-one AI framework for semantic search, LLM orchestration and language model workflows

Weaviate is an open-source vector database that stores both objects and vectors, allowing for the combination of vector search with structured filtering with the fault tolerance and scalability of a cloud-native database​.
Embeddable vector database for Go with Chroma-like interface and zero third-party dependencies. In-memory with optional persistence.
An official Qdrant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation
Open-source web search API and MCP server for LLMs, AI agents, and RAG. Free sources, self-hosted SearXNG, REST, CLI.

Open-source enterprise search + generative AI platform. Faceted semantic search, hybrid BM25+vector ranking, RAG chat with citations, AI agents and MCP tools — on Apache Solr, Elasticsearch or embedded Lucene. Indexes Adobe AEM, WordPress, databases and files via the Viglet Dumont connectors. Self-hosted Apache-2.0 alternative to Algolia and Coveo.
